name: Kevin Wang
description: A little about Kevin Wang: statistics, writing, and places along the way.

timeline.title: MS in Statistics
timeline.description: Continuing my studies in statistics, with coursework in Bayesian inference, time series, and statistical computing. Expected graduation: May 2027.

timeline.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
timeline.description: Studied how sports injuries affect performance using Bayesian hierarchical models. Worked in R and Stan to improve model efficiency and test results across more than 1,000 simulation scenarios.

timeline.title: A semester in Beijing
timeline.description: Spent four months on exchange at Tsinghua, as part of five months in China. Studying, playing sports, and finding time to explore.

timeline.title: Actuarial Automation Intern
timeline.description: Built VBA tools to automate insurance policy illustrations and data entry, saving more than two hours of manual processing per run.

timeline.title: Actuarial Data Analytics Intern
timeline.description: Worked on claims forecasting and reporting using regression, SQL, and Power BI. Improved a forecasting model and helped make monthly reporting more efficient.

timeline.title: BS in Statistics & Computer Science
timeline.description: Studied statistics and computer science, with a minor in management. Along the way: hackathons, course grading, and a growing interest in research.

interests.title: Sports
interests.text: Basketball, hockey, football, and swimming. I grew up playing sports; these days I enjoy watching them, too.

interests.title: Around a table
interests.text: Catan with friends, a game of chess, or poker. My exchange in China also introduced me to mahjong.

interests.title: Books & words
interests.text: Reading before bed and occasionally putting my own thoughts into words. A few of those thoughts have made it onto this site.
